_: Who answers the house (or stands, votes, cheers or hoots by its own record) in each hall scene, as who@bench: pinned, so that a change to the rule shows here. Smolny's as drawn before the Duma's halls (the side of the rising); the Duma's from Reed: 'imprecations from the right'; the Bolsheviki 'followed by cries'; the Bolshevik benches' 'ironic laughter'; Zinoviev 'hooted down' when 'most of the delegates were hostile', so all but the Bolsheviki, the gallery and those walking out. At Fontanka 6 the hall laughs at Tchernov ('a great burst of laughter') and rises for the Smolny delegation ('a rising ovation'), the delegation walking in. Tchernov's return to the Alexander Hall: the Bolsheviki 'on their feet all at once, shaking their fists'. The Council of the Republic: nobody answers on 5 November; on 6 November the Left's 'Uproar' at Kerensky; the Bolshevik seats empty. The Riding School: the armoured-car men cheering as they reach the left ('victorious roaring'); those 'left stranded' walk out, the committee on the car does not answer. Some of a body with a pose of their own are pinned as who@bench:part: at the Land Decree the hall votes ('put to vote, with only one against') and the Congress's 'Peasants' Deputies' cheer ('the peasant delegates wild with joy'); at the press decree 'a part of the Bolsheviki' applauds with the Left Socialist Revolutionaries while the rest hoot Larin; at Tchernov's return 'some of the Left Socialist Revolutionaries' are on their feet with the Bolsheviki, and 'the rest of the assembly tried to yell them down' (each body's own pose: the Right Socialist Revolutionaries are Tchernov's party, and a hoot by the whole hall spares the speaker's).
